study type: Post-hoc analysis of prospective observational studies
cohort: Stable preterm and term infants undergoing cerebral NIRS monitoring and blood gas analysis immediately after birth.
finding: In preterm infants, higher pCO2 was associated with lower crSO2 and higher cFTOE/cTOE, while no such associations were observed in term infants, suggesting a less pronounced vasodilatative effect of pCO2 in preterm infants during immediate postnatal transition.
gest_age: Preterm infants: median 34.8 (IQR 32.7-36.1) weeks; Term infants: 39.0 (IQR 38.5-38.9) weeks
